Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Scrum master who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

SAFe; Scrum; Kanban; jira; Agile

Familiarity with Scrum and Agile methodologies;

Basic knowledge of project management tools (e.g., Jira, Trello) is an advantage;

Understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts and experience with applications hosted in cloud environments is preferred;

Eager to learn and grow in project management and cloud technology areas;

Advanced proficiency in English

Certification (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) is a plus but not required.

Should have worked at least 2-3 years as a Scrum Master;

Very good in Communication(English);

Experience in Project Management will be added advantage;

Should able to manage multiple Scrum Calls and Teams together;

Good understanding Consumer retail Business;

Well versed with Jira.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

SAFe; Scrum; Kanban; jira; Agile

Familiarity with Scrum and Agile methodologies;

title: Executivo de Território
description:
Estamos em busca de um profissional dinâmico e motivado para integrar nossa equipe comercial. Se você é apaixonado por desafios, tem atitude de dono e busca uma carreira de sucesso, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades:

  • Visitar entre 8 a 12 Farmácias de pequeno e médio porte da região;
  • Planejar e identificar as oportunidades de vendas, verificar, executar MPDV, dentro das rotinas do PEX (Programa de Excelência) na base de PDVs;
  • Atingir as metas de vendas estabelecidas;
  • Participar das reuniões diárias – matinal e fechamento de vendas on-line, de segunda à sexta.
  • Participar de treinamentos e eventos para atualização e desenvolvimento profissional;


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
  • Capacidade analítica verificar e atuar nas oportunidades;
  • Disciplina para cumprimento de rotina;
  • Disposição para trabalhos externos e viagens estaduais;
  • Carteira de motorista B;
  • Experiência Comercial Bens de consumo, Bebidas, Sorvete, Canal conveniência, setor de Adquirência (desejável);
  • Proatividade, atitude de dono e foco em resultados;
  • Desejável: Cursando Ensino Superior (Cursos prioritários: Engenharias, Economia, Física, Estatísticas, Matemática, Adm,)
  • Residir em Bacabal/MA.


Motivos para trabalhar na Legrand:

  • A Legrand oferece uma carreira acelerada com oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento real, em uma cultura de crescimento e meritocracia;

A Legrand hoje:

  • Empresa com mais de 100 SKUs, sendo 25 produtos líderes ou vice-líderes de mercado;
  • Faturamento anual superior a R$1 bilhão, com destaque para o produto Expec, que gera R$300 milhões por ano;

História recente:

  • Nos últimos três anos e meio, a Legrand dobrou de tamanho, aumentou seu market share e subiu duas posições no ranking, agora sendo a terceira maior;
  • Quintuplicou o número de colaboradores e foi certificada no ranking GTPW de melhores empresas para trabalhar nos últimos dois anos;
  • Novo lema “Viva a Vida”, focado em criar marcas amadas pelos consumidores.

title: Agile Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Agile Facilitator who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

English fluently

Agile projets

Project Management

Facilitate and coordinate Agile Scrum processes within the company.

Guide and coach the team on Agile Scrum principles and practices.

Ensure the team works collaboratively and efficiently to deliver high-quality products.

Agile Ways of Working, Scrum, SAFe knowledge. Hands on Jira/ADO

SAFe

Jira

Scrum

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Agile Facilitator who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

English fluently

Agile projets

Project Management

Facilitate and coordinate Agile Scrum processes within the company.

Guide and coach the team on Agile Scrum principles and practices.

Ensure the team works collaboratively and efficiently to deliver high-quality products.

Agile Ways of Working, Scrum, SAFe knowledge. Hands on Jira/ADO

SAFe

Jira

Scrum

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

ID:

title: Executivo de Território
description:
Estamos em busca de um profissional dinâmico e motivado para integrar nossa equipe comercial. Se você é apaixonado por desafios, tem atitude de dono e busca uma carreira de sucesso, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades:

  • Visitar entre 8 a 12 Farmácias de pequeno e médio porte da região;
  • Planejar e identificar as oportunidades de vendas, verificar, executar MPDV, dentro das rotinas do PEX (Programa de Excelência) na base de PDVs;
  • Atingir as metas de vendas estabelecidas;
  • Participar das reuniões diárias – matinal e fechamento de vendas on-line, de segunda à sexta.
  • Participar de treinamentos e eventos para atualização e desenvolvimento profissional;


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
  • Capacidade analítica verificar e atuar nas oportunidades;
  • Disciplina para cumprimento de rotina;
  • Disposição para trabalhos externos e viagens estaduais;
  • Carteira de motorista B;
  • Experiência Comercial Bens de consumo, Bebidas, Sorvete, Canal conveniência, setor de Adquirência (desejável);
  • Proatividade, atitude de dono e foco em resultados;
  • Desejável: Cursando Ensino Superior (Cursos prioritários: Engenharias, Economia, Física, Estatísticas, Matemática, Adm,)


Motivos para trabalhar na Legrand:

  • A Legrand oferece uma carreira acelerada com oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento real, em uma cultura de crescimento e meritocracia;

A Legrand hoje:

  • Empresa com mais de 100 SKUs, sendo 25 produtos líderes ou vice-líderes de mercado;
  • Faturamento anual superior a R$1 bilhão, com destaque para o produto Expec, que gera R$300 milhões por ano;

História recente:

  • Nos últimos três anos e meio, a Legrand dobrou de tamanho, aumentou seu market share e subiu duas posições no ranking, agora sendo a terceira maior;
  • Quintuplicou o número de colaboradores e foi certificada no ranking GTPW de melhores empresas para trabalhar nos últimos dois anos;
  • Novo lema “Viva a Vida”, focado em criar marcas amadas pelos consumidores.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Scrum master who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

SAFe; Scrum; Kanban; jira; Agile

Familiarity with Scrum and Agile methodologies;

Basic knowledge of project management tools (e.g., Jira, Trello) is an advantage;

Understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts and experience with applications hosted in cloud environments is preferred;

Eager to learn and grow in project management and cloud technology areas;

Advanced proficiency in English

Certification (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) is a plus but not required.

Should have worked at least 2-3 years as a Scrum Master;

Very good in Communication(English);

Experience in Project Management will be added advantage;

Should able to manage multiple Scrum Calls and Teams together;

Good understanding Consumer retail Business;

Well versed with Jira.

ID:

title: PMO Especialista - Desenvolvimento de Negócios
description:
A Química Anastacio é uma das maiores distribuidoras de produtos químicos da América Latina e oferece um amplo portfólio de produtos e ingredientes, além de soluções e serviços inteligentes, auxiliando os clientes e fornecedores no crescimento dos seus negócios. Contamos com uma excelente estrutura comercial, logística e técnica, e atendemos todas as indústrias do mercado.


Nos últimos anos, fortalecemos nossas operações transformando em ágil, simples e focada no cliente. Hoje temos 6 centros de distribuições localizados estrategicamente no Brasil, presença na Argentina e México, com meta de expandir nossa participação no mercado da América Latina e representamos cerca de 400 fornecedores globais.


Para mais informações, visite


Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciar o portfólio de projetos de desenvolvimento de negócios: novos produtos, fornecedores, segmentos e parcerias estratégicas.
  • Avaliar e implantar softwares e métodos de gestão de projetos, assegurando documentação estruturada e padronização de processos.
  • Promover reuniões de acompanhamento (diárias, semanais e mensais) com as equipes envolvidas, garantindo alinhamento e ritmo nas entregas.
  • Implantar e aprimorar ferramentas de gestão de projetos e governanças corporativas que garantam análises de viabilidade técnicas e financeiras de forma ágil e padronizada.
  • Estruturar e treinar os stakeholders em metodologias de projeto, governança e ferramentas de acompanhamento.
  • Liderar o calendário de business reports , consolidando resultados, impacto financeiro, desvios críticos e aprendizados.
  • Definir e aplicar critérios de priorização de projetos , criando uma matriz de decisão estratégica e coordenando fóruns de go/no go.
  • Construir e monitorar o pipeline de projetos , com SLAs e indicadores de eficiência (tempo, esforço, retorno, margem).
  • Mapear recursos necessários (financeiros, humanos e técnicos) e propor otimizações de alocação.
  • Estruturar o pool de oportunidades da companhia, centralizando ideias, mensurando impactos e apoiando a tomada de decisão executiva.
  • Coordenar o Comitê LATAM , garantindo integração de governança com México e Argentina.


Formação:

  • Graduação completa (Administração, Engenharia, Química ou áreas correlatas);
  • Pós-graduação ou certificações (PMP, Scrum Master, Lean, PM², etc.) são diferenciais.
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado.
  • Experiência prévia com gestão de portfólio de projetos , preferencialmente em empresas B2B industriais, químicas ou de distribuição.
  • Vivência em implantação de PMO , gestão de performance e estruturação de governança.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, visão sistêmica e habilidade para conectar estratégia, operação e resultado financeiro .
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade para conduzir fóruns executivos multidisciplinares.


Local de trabalho : Pinheiros, São Paulo - SP

Modelo híbrido : 3 dias presencial na semana

Horário de trabalho : Segunda à sexta-feira das 8h00 às 17h45

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Agile Facilitator who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

English fluently

Agile projets

Project Management

Facilitate and coordinate Agile Scrum processes within the company.

Guide and coach the team on Agile Scrum principles and practices.

Ensure the team works collaboratively and efficiently to deliver high-quality products.

Agile Ways of Working, Scrum, SAFe knowledge. Hands on Jira/ADO

SAFe

Jira

Scrum

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

description:
A Rich é uma empresa de cultura ímpar! Aqui, vemos o trabalho como uma saborosa sobremesa, um verdadeiro presente!


Somos uma família em busca de pessoas que queiram viver uma experiência diferenciada com infinitas possibilidades de sucesso. Uma multinacional líder e pioneiro no mercado em que atuamos, oferecendo produtos e serviços no segmento de Confeitaria e Panificação.


A Rich do Brasil detém um conhecimento global em soluções integradas para confeitaria com produtos (Congelados/Frozen e UHT). Ao adquirirem produtos da marca RICH’S®, os clientes recebem serviços únicos, que os ajudam a “vender mais e melhor”.


Entender as necessidades dos clientes e atendê-los de forma diferenciada está no DNA de todos que fazem parte desta família, afinal trabalhamos com produtos que agregam valor à nossas comemorações, às reuniões de empresas, aniversários, indo do café da manhã até o happy hour.

Nossa matriz no Brasil está localizada no Bairro da Barra Funda, temos 02 fábricas que estão localizadas em Sorocaba e Mairinque.


RICH’S®, cuidando de sua confeitaria com o carinho de uma FAMILIA.

Já imaginou fazer parte de uma empresa líder neste mercado?


O nosso time de Recursos Humanos trabalha todos os dias para IDENTIFICAR, DESENVOLVER, PREPARAR E ENERGIZAR pessoas talentosas para alcançarmos resultados excepcionais!


Somos uma empresa que detém o selo das melhores empresas para se trabalhar - GPTW e nos orgulhamos muito de todos os profissionais que fazem parte desta conquista!


Se você está em busca de uma carreira plena e desafiadora e valoriza uma cultura corporativa familiar, nós temos a oportunidade para você! A Rich do Brasil é uma subsidiária da Rich Products Corporation e está fundamentada em valores sólidos que cultivam a inovação, o foco no cliente e uma atitude de sempre fazer o que é certo.

Profissional que seja responsável, que cumpra as normas de higiene e segurança alimentar, com residência em Fortaleza ou Maracanaú/CE.

Atendimento na produção de confeitarias, padarias e supermercados promovendo aumento do sell out e introdução do mix de produtos, garantir o cumprimento das normas de higiene e segurança alimentar (BPF - Boas Práticas de Fabricação), realizar apresentações e treinamentos em grandes redes.

title: Pessoa Analista de Sucesso do Cliente Sênior - Key Accounts
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Missão do cargo :

Garantir e potencializar as estratégias dos clientes, conectando seus objetivos de negócio às soluções tecnológicas da Neoway.


Responsabilidades:

  • Tornar-se especialista nos produtos Neoway e utilizar esse conhecimento para guiar efetivamente os clientes em direção aos seus resultados desejados;
  • Gerenciar um portfólio de clientes, monitorando resultados, mapeando riscos, antecipando necessidades e direcionando estratégias de retenção;
  • Criação e manutenção de relacionamento com alta liderança (gerentes, heads e diretores) das contas estratégicas;
  • Realizar o planejamento de contas (Account Planning), identificando, desenvolvendo e aplicando estratégias de upsell e cross-sell;
  • Conduzir rotinas de atendimento e acompanhamento, incluindo elaboração de QBRs, apresentações executivas, análises consultivas e estudos de mercado.
  • Monitorar métricas de sucesso do cliente e garantir a visibilidade dos resultados alcançados;
  • Mapear e desenvolver cases de sucesso, além de avaliar e evidenciar o retorno sobre o investimento (ROI) dos projetos;
  • Elaborar e apresentar estudos estratégicos para os clientes;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas internas da companhia para garantir atendimento eficiente à solicitações dos clientes;



Você fará a diferença se apresentar:

  • Experiência prévia em empresas SaaS.
  • Habilidade em planejamento de contas e acompanhamento de projetos.
  • Forte capacidade analítica para elaborar e apresentar estudos estratégicos aos clientes.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e implementação de estratégias de upsell e cross-sell.
  • Elevada capacidade de engajar clientes, demonstrar valor e acompanhar resultados de negócio.
  • Conhecimento em métricas de sucesso do cliente e avaliação de ROI de projetos.
  • Mentalidade proativa e colaborativa, com ótima gestão do tempo e capacidade de atuar com múltiplas contas e demandas simultaneamente.
  • Autonomia, proatividade e accountability.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
TITAN is a no-code, web-based, fast paced growing startup within the Salesforce ecosystem. Our platform allows for seamless form creation, data collection, and workflow automation, all with no coding required. We are looking to hire Customer Success Managers to join our growing Customer Success team in North America.


As a Customer Success Manager , you'll manage client onboarding, expansions, and renewals while leveraging technical expertise with a strategic business mindset to build strong customer relationships and identify growth opportunities. Join our innovative CS team to drive success and collaborate with Sales, Product, Solutions, and Support teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers, ensuring seamless onboarding, training, and adoption.
  • Lead discovery meetings with key users and stakeholders from customers and partners to position Titan as a core system and focus on maximizing its value.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to drive engagement and long-term success.
  • Identify upsell and expansion opportunities by aligning product capabilities with customer needs.
  • Analyze customer usage data to proactively address risks and drive retention strategies.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and proactively address issues to drive customer satisfaction and retention.


Requirements:

  • 2-4 years of proven experience as a Customer Success Manager or Technical Account Manager in a SaaS company (must ).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong customer-facing abilities, including a willingness to meet clients onsite and lead business discussions.
  • Experience in identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities and working closely with Sales.
  • Hands-on experience with onboarding and implementation processes of Salesforce or other CRMs - a must.
  • A can-do approach with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure.
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.
  • Ability to work remotely across EST/PST time zones.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Business or equivalent experience.


Why Join TITAN?:

  • Work with a dynamic and innovative team in a fast-growing SaaS startup
  • Collaborate with industry-leading clients and gain exposure to cutting-edge technologies
  • Enjoy the flexibility of remote work and a healthy work-life balance
  • Competitive compensation package and opportunities for professional growth and development

title: Engenheiro Eletricista
description:
Buscamos um profissional que será responsável por executar e avaliar a viabilidade das estratégias de gestão de energia, visando promover a validação técnica de documentos e projetos para a área, visando práticas eficientes e compatíveis com os objetivos organizacionais do Grupo Pereira.


Se interessou e faz sentido para você e para a sua carreira? Veja as principais atividades:

• Promover a avaliação e validação técnica das estratégias e projetos de gestão de energia, através da elaboração de laudos técnicos, projetos de instalações elétricas de baixa tensão, de telefonia, de som, de cabeamento estruturado, de SPDA, entre outros;

• Suporte ao departamento de Manutenção, através da condução de processos relacionados à engenharia elétrica, desde a análise inicial à execução;

• Contribuir com disponibilidade de energia para todas as unidades de negócio e expansão, através da elaboração e execução de projetos de engenharia elétrica;

• Promover o atendimento às especificações técnicas da área, através da elaboração de documentação e laudos para os sistemas e equipamentos elétricos utilizados;

• Contribuir para o planejamento e controle de projetos de engenharia, por meio de relatórios técnicos do segmento de atuação;

• Contribuir com a disponibilidade de recursos e soluções em gestão de energia, por meio da identificação de oportunidades de otimização, análise de novas tecnologias, pesquisas de benchmarking e etc;

• Realizar pesquisas de novos fornecedores de equipamentos e tecnologias, através de benchmarking, propondo soluções que atendam às necessidades do negócio.


O que esperamos do(a) nosso(a) Eng. Eletricista:

• Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Elétrica com registro no conselho ativo (CREA);

• Disponibilidade para residir em Campo Grande/MS;

title: Product Owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY


JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree


FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields


EXPERIENCE;

  • At least 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.


COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus


ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
TITAN is a no-code, web-based, fast paced growing startup within the Salesforce ecosystem. Our platform allows for seamless form creation, data collection, and workflow automation, all with no coding required. We are looking to hire Customer Success Managers to join our growing Customer Success team in North America.


As a Customer Success Manager , you'll manage client onboarding, expansions, and renewals while leveraging technical expertise with a strategic business mindset to build strong customer relationships and identify growth opportunities. Join our innovative CS team to drive success and collaborate with Sales, Product, Solutions, and Support teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers, ensuring seamless onboarding, training, and adoption.
  • Lead discovery meetings with key users and stakeholders from customers and partners to position Titan as a core system and focus on maximizing its value.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to drive engagement and long-term success.
  • Identify upsell and expansion opportunities by aligning product capabilities with customer needs.
  • Analyze customer usage data to proactively address risks and drive retention strategies.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and proactively address issues to drive customer satisfaction and retention.


Requirements:

  • 2-4 years of proven experience as a Customer Success Manager or Technical Account Manager in a SaaS company (must ).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong customer-facing abilities, including a willingness to meet clients onsite and lead business discussions.
  • Experience in identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities and working closely with Sales.
  • Hands-on experience with onboarding and implementation processes of Salesforce or other CRMs - a must.
  • A can-do approach with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure.
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.
  • Ability to work remotely across EST/PST time zones.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Business or equivalent experience.


Why Join TITAN?:

  • Work with a dynamic and innovative team in a fast-growing SaaS startup
  • Collaborate with industry-leading clients and gain exposure to cutting-edge technologies
  • Enjoy the flexibility of remote work and a healthy work-life balance
  • Competitive compensation package and opportunities for professional growth and development

title: Elementary Homeroom Teacher in Mexico City - Native English Speaker
description:
The Churchill School & College Mexico City is looking to appoint an enthusiastic and committed Primary Teacher to work with a dedicated team in the Primary department (KS2) to start in AUGUST 2026.


The Churchill School & College, part of The Anglo Foundation, offers bilingual education for students aged 2 to 18. It is an authorized center for IB (Primary Years, Middle Years, Diploma) and Cambridge (Primary, Lower Secondary, Upper Secondary) programs.

Located in Mexico City, a vibrant and culturally rich metropolis, the school provides teachers with housing in a popular residential area near the campus, with easy access to restaurants, shopping, theaters, and public transportation.


The successful applicant for this position will:

  • Hold a BA Degree in Education (mandatory)
  • Be a Native English Speaker (mandatory)
  • Be passionate about teaching and learning
  • Hold a relevant degree and Qualified Teacher Status or equivalent
  • Have at least two years of teaching experience
  • Have experience in, or knowledge of, IB and Cambridge programmes (preferred)
  • Be able to engage and motivate students
  • Use assessment for learning tools, adapting instruction to individual needs
  • Seek to consistently improve their practice
  • Promote the values of the school
  • Thrive in an inclusive school environment


In return, we will offer you:

• students who are inquirers and highly motivated by dynamic teaching

• well-educated parents who are committed to the school and their children’s learning

• personal and professional development opportunities, including career growth within the school and under the umbrella of The Anglo Foundation

• a competitive salary (with additional benefits)

• an accommodation allowance

• a flight allowance

• an initial 2-year contract (renewable annually thereafter)

• private health insurance, including comprehensive dental care

• an excellent working environment with supportive and committed staff


APPLICATION PROCESS

If you would like to be part of the Churchill family, we look forward to receiving your application.

title: Inspetor de qualidade
description:
1. Missão do Cargo


Garantir que produtos, processos e materiais atendam aos requisitos especificados pela empresa, clientes e normas aplicáveis, por meio de inspeções, registros e monitoramentos sistemáticos, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade.


⸻


2. Principais Responsabilidades

• Realizar inspeções de recebimento, processo e produto final, conforme procedimentos e planos de inspeção.

• Registrar e manter atualizados os resultados das inspeções nos formulários, sistemas ou relatórios definidos.

• Identificar, segregar e registrar materiais ou produtos não conformes, comunicando aos responsáveis.

• Apoiar na investigação de não conformidades, realizar análises preliminares e sugerir ações corretivas/ver preventivas.

• Utilizar instrumentos de medição (paquímetro, micrômetro, gabaritos, etc.) garantindo conformidade com padrões.

• Preencher relatórios de inspeção, laudos e demais documentos relacionados ao controle da qualidade.

• Acompanhar testes e ensaios, garantindo que sejam cumpridos os requisitos técnicos.

• Auxiliar no monitoramento de indicadores da qualidade.

• Cumprir e fazer cumprir os procedimentos do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade (ISO 9001 ou outros aplicáveis).

• Sugerir melhorias nos processos, produtos e métodos de inspeção.


⸻


3. Competências Técnicas

• Leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos (quando aplicável).

• Uso de instrumentos de medição e inspeção.

• Conhecimento básico/intermediário da ISO 9001.

• Registro e controle de não conformidades.

• Noções de ferramentas da qualidade (5S, diagrama de causa e efeito, PDCA, etc.).


⸻


4. Competências Comportamentais

• Atenção aos detalhes.

• Organização e disciplina nos registros.

• Comunicação clara e objetiva.

• Proatividade e foco em melhoria contínua.

• Imparcialidade e postura ética.

• Trabalho em equipe.


⸻


5. Formação e Experiência

• Ensino médio completo (técnico em qualidade ou áreas afins é diferencial).

• Experiência prévia em inspeção ou controle de qualidade.

• Desejável conhecimento em metrologia.

• Treinamentos específicos conforme a área de atuação (ex.: inspeção visual, instrumentos, processo produtivo).


⸻


6. Indicadores de Desempenho (KPIs)

• Taxa de retrabalho.

• Acuracidade de inspeção.

• Registros realizados dentro do prazo.

• Redução de não conformidades internas e externas.

• Cumprimento dos procedimentos de qualidade.


TER EXPERIÊNCIA EM CALDEIRARIA E DIMENSIONAL

title: MSP Delivery Specialist (Bilingual English | Portuguese)
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a trusted leader in workforce solutions and managed service provider (MSP) operations. We partner with enterprise clients to streamline contingent workforce management, strengthen supplier relationships, and ensure program compliance. Our mission is to deliver operational excellence through technology-driven solutions, industry expertise, and exceptional service quality across all facets of workforce delivery.


Summary

Pinnacle Group is seeking an MSP Delivery Specialist to manage the full life cycle of contingent workforce requests. This role serves as a key point of contact for client hiring managers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring seamless requisition management, compliance, and operational success. The ideal candidate has strong experience in recruitment, MSP operations, and Vendor Management Systems (VMS), combined with a customer service mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.


Job Description

  • Train, assist, and facilitate the requisition life cycle with client hiring managers and suppliers.
  • Support large-scale hiring initiatives, VMS data integrity projects, and supplier rationalization efforts.
  • Conduct intake calls, qualify candidate resumes, and manage requisition flow from posting through fulfillment.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with hiring managers, suppliers, and internal program teams to ensure program success.
  • Maintain a service-focused approach, delivering a high-quality experience to all stakeholders.
  • Utilize and provide training on MSP tool such as Beeline and applications including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Ensure timely and accurate submission of required documentation by suppliers, maintaining adherence to SLAs and KPIs.
  • Support reporting, analytics, and client-specific initiatives as assigned.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience, preferably in a business-related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in MSP operations, or contingent workforce management .
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and experience with Beeline
  • Bilingual Competency across English and Portuguese
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts clearly.
  • Proven success in a client-facing, fast-paced, and service-oriented environment.
  • Self-starter who can work independently and exercise sound judgment in ambiguous situations.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities with a solution-driven mindset.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy under tight deadlines.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you’ll play a vital role in advancing workforce solutions that power some of the world’s leading organizations. We foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth. You’ll have the opportunity to strengthen your MSP expertise, build strategic relationships, and make a meaningful impact in a company that values excellence and accountability.


Compensation and Benefits Disclosure

The specific compensation for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role as well as the cost of labor in the market; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. Our full-time consultants have access to benefits including medical, dental, vision and 401K contributions as well as any other PTO, sick leave, and other benefits mandated by appliable state or localities where you reside or work.
